description: Focused LLM review repair for backend aggregation where-filter execution.

userStories.title: Apply Aggregation Where Filters Server-Side
userStories.description: As a pipeline and operations analyst using Aggregation, I want the backend aggregate endpoint to apply the where filter sent by the UI, so aggregate results reflect the filtered object set and column policy cannot be bypassed through where fields.

acceptanceCriteria.given: an aggregate request includes a where clause that matches only active employees
acceptanceCriteria.then: the returned count is scoped to matching rows and differs from the unfiltered aggregate

acceptanceCriteria.given: the caller can aggregate visible properties but the where clause references a hidden property
acceptanceCriteria.when: the aggregate endpoint evaluates the request policy
acceptanceCriteria.then: the request is rejected with PropertyNotAccessible for the hidden where field

acceptanceCriteria.given: a scenario-overlay aggregate request includes a where clause
acceptanceCriteria.when: scenario edits are folded over the base rows
acceptanceCriteria.then: the where clause filters the post-overlay rows before metrics and groupBy buckets are computed
